_: One component, described once and referenced by every machine that carries it. A CPU is the same CPU in whatever box it is bolted into, so what is written here is what is true of the part — never of a particular machine.

identity._match: cpu family, model and stepping from /proc/cpuinfo. Not the model *string*, which vendors reword between microcode releases.

power._measured: package draw on this site idles near 27 W, which is what makes the fan finding below so stark

no_turbo._note: the kernel spells this inverted; Furcate carries the operator's meaning and inverts at the write

thermal._observed: zero PROCHOT events on this site, ever — the silicon has never been near its limit
